policy.compact_provenance: Complete committed immutable Lee source retains all1,449 needed original records/34,610 typed cells, complete headers, notes, primary definitions and outside identities, plus all exact omitted original ordinal/identity/population inventories and raw digests. policy.eligibility: Reconstruct exact original CCD and FDOE district36 identities, operational status and complete pure lower offered flags. policy.identity: Exact original2024–25 CCD LEA1201080 /FL-36 and FDOE district36 identities. policy.income: Florida 2024–25 Final Survey 3 (February) raw individual Lunch Status counts: D/F free eligibility + 3/E reduced eligibility + C/R CEP direct certification, divided by same-survey enrolled students (PK–12).
